meta.title: Extend with one minute left while a vendor is typing
gaps: The prepared event is not guaranteed to have exactly one minute remaining before extension.
Concurrent vendor typing while the buyer extends the event and submission exactly two minutes later cannot be synchronized or asserted.

plan.title: Extend RFQ Near Deadline and Accept Vendor Bid

steps.note: Open the existing prepared live RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Extend the live RFQ submission window by 15 minutes and verify Procol saves the new end time.
Move to the separate supplier portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the prepared event's RFQ bid sheet as the invited vendor.
Submit Vendor A's bid of 95 after the extension.
Verify the vendor portal accepted the bid and shows the stage as Submitted.
